sentences.l2: 近年来，都市白领中掀起了一股健身热潮。
sentences.l1: In recent years, a fitness craze has swept through urban white-collar workers.

sentences.l2: 下班之后，越来越多的年轻人不再满足于宅在家里，而是走进健身房，用汗水对抗久坐带来的疲惫。
sentences.l1: After work, more and more young people are no longer content to stay at home, but walk into the gym and use sweat to fight the fatigue brought on by sitting for long periods.

sentences.l2: 他们往往在年初兴冲冲地办卡，立志重塑身材，可真正坚持下来的却是少数。
sentences.l1: They often sign up for a membership eagerly at the start of the year, resolving to reshape their bodies, but those who truly keep going are only a minority.

sentences.l2: 为了突破瓶颈，不少人选择聘请私教。
sentences.l1: To break through the plateau, quite a few people choose to hire a personal trainer.

sentences.l2: 私教能根据个人体质与目标制定方案，及时纠正动作，避免运动损伤，这在很大程度上提高了训练的安全性，但高昂的费用也让一些人望而却步。
sentences.l1: A personal trainer can draw up a plan according to an individual's physique and goals, correct movements in time, and avoid exercise injuries, which to a great extent improves the safety of training, but the high cost also deters some people.

sentences.l2: 如今，减肥已不再是唯一诉求。
sentences.l1: Nowadays, losing weight is no longer the only demand.

sentences.l2: 许多人把健身视为一种生活方式，一种在高压工作中重建秩序感的方式。
sentences.l1: Many people regard fitness as a way of life, a way of rebuilding a sense of order amid high-pressure work.

sentences.l2: 他们在社交平台上打卡，记录体重与心情的变化，彼此激励，也彼此比较。
sentences.l1: They check in on social platforms, record changes in their weight and mood, and encourage each other, and also compare themselves with each other.

sentences.l2: 这种可视化的坚持，让枯燥的重复变得有意义——塑造身体的从来不是一时的决心，而是日复一日的自律。
sentences.l1: This visible perseverance makes dull repetition meaningful: what shapes the body is never a moment's resolve, but self-discipline day after day.
